title: Rabbi Zuhamai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman records only one mention of him, in Berakhot 53b: “Our Rabbis taught: Oil is indispensable for the blessing — the words of Rabbi Zilai. Rabbi Zuhamai says: Just as one who is soiled is unfit for the Temple service, so soiled hands are unfit for the blessing.” The Gaon Rabbi Tzvi Hirsch Chajes holds that he was called Rabbi Zuhamai after the halakhah he stated.

notes.text: In the meal context שמן מעכב means oil is indispensable, not that it hinders. Saved Rashi on Berakhot 53b explains oil used after the meal to clean grease from the hands. Hyman’s limited-attestation observation remains his own.
